CREATE VIEW view_premium_quality_scans AS
SELECT 
    s.questregistry AS scan_id,
    p.vesseltag AS project,
    st.zonelabel AS site,
    s.chronotag AS timestamp,
    sp.scanresolmm AS resolution,
    sp.pointdense AS density,
    sp.coverpct AS coverage,
    sp.lappct AS overlap,
    sp.noisedb AS noise_level
FROM scans s
JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry
JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
JOIN scanpointcloud sp ON s.arcref = sp.arcref
JOIN scanqc sqc ON s.arcref = sqc.arcref
WHERE 
    -- High Resolution Scan: ScanResolMm <= 1.0 AND PointDense >= 1000
    sp.scanresolmm <= 1.0
    AND sp.pointdense >= 1000
    -- Comprehensive Coverage: CoverPct >= 95 AND LapPct >= 30
    AND sp.coverpct >= 95
    AND sp.lappct >= 30
    -- Noise below 1.5
    AND sp.noisedb < 1.5
    -- SQS > 7.5 where SQS = ((10/SRI)^1.5) * (SCE/100) * (1 - NoiseDb/30)^2
    -- SRI = (log10(ScanResolMm * 1000) / log10(PointDense)) * 5
    -- SCE = CoverPct * (1 + (LapPct/100) * (1 - CoverPct/100))
    AND POWER((POWER(10.0 / (LOG(sp.scanresolmm * 1000.0) / LOG(sp.pointdense) * 5.0), 1.5)), 1.0) 
        * (sp.coverpct * (1.0 + (sp.lappct / 100.0) * (1.0 - sp.coverpct / 100.0)) / 100.0)
        * POWER((1.0 - sp.noisedb / 30.0), 2.0) > 7.5;
